question: Which class has the Navy ship 'Tavasya', which was launched in 2025, been included in?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Stealth frigate**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Navy ship 'Tavasya' has been included in the category of stealth frigates.** Stealth frigates are a class of warships designed with advanced technologies to minimize their radar, infrared, acoustic, and magnetic signatures, which makes them less detectable to enemy forces.
 
• The stealth frigate class is known for its **cutting-edge design**, which incorporates angled surfaces, radar-absorbing materials, and special coatings to reduce the visibility of the ship to radar systems. These features enhance its **stealth capabilities**.
 
• Stealth frigates are equipped with **advanced weaponry** and sensor systems that allow them to perform a variety of missions, including anti-submarine warfare, air defense, and surface warfare.
 
• The stealth frigate class is typically used for **coastal and open sea operations, as well as in sensitive or hostile waters**. Their stealth features allow them to conduct operations with a lower risk of detection.
 
• The inclusion of 'Tavasya' in the stealth frigate class indicates that it is likely a highly modernized and technologically advanced warship that will play a significant role in enhancing the operational capabilities of the Navy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Characteristics of Stealth Frigates:**

 
 
• Stealth frigates are characterized by their ability to operate in stealth mode, which allows them to remain undetected by enemy radar systems. This is achieved through **special hull designs** and **radar-absorbent materials**.
 
• They are equipped with advanced technologies for **anti-submarine warfare**, **air defense**, and **surface warfare**, making them versatile and effective naval assets.
 
• Stealth frigates are designed to operate in a variety of maritime environments, including open oceans and coastal waters. They are an important asset for countries aiming to protect their maritime boundaries and assert naval dominance.
 
 
 
• **Other Ship Classes:**
 
 
• **Ballistic Submarines:** These are submarines designed to launch **ballistic missiles**. They are primarily used for nuclear deterrence and are not categorized as surface ships like frigates.
 
• **Surveillance Ships:** These ships are specialized for **intelligence gathering**, surveillance, and reconnaissance. They are equipped with sensors and communication equipment rather than combat capabilities.
 
• **Corvettes:** Corvettes are smaller than frigates and are primarily used for **patrolling coastal areas**. They are not typically equipped with the advanced stealth capabilities of modern stealth frigates.
 
 
 
• **Examples of Stealth Frigates:**
 
 
• **INS Shivalik:** An Indian Navy stealth frigate and the lead ship of the Shivalik-class frigates. It features stealth technology and advanced weapons systems.
 
• **Admiral Gorshkov-class:** A Russian Navy class of stealth frigates known for their advanced combat systems and stealth features.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Stealth Technology:**

 
 
• Stealth ships are designed to minimize their radar, infrared, acoustic, and magnetic signatures, making them harder to detect by enemy forces. These features are critical for modern naval warfare.
 
• The stealth technology includes the use of **angled surfaces**, **radar-absorbent materials**, and **reduced thermal emissions**.
 
 
 
• **Role of Stealth Frigates:**
 
 
• Stealth frigates play a crucial role in **naval operations**, including escorting larger ships, engaging in anti-submarine warfare, and providing air defense for naval fleets.
 
• They are often deployed in high-risk areas where their stealth capabilities allow them to operate with a higher degree of safety and effectiveness.
